parts.name: Root
parts.description: The stateful container. Owns the committed date value, the popover open state, and validation shared by the input and calendar.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the root element. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled date value (YYYY-MM-DD). Bindable. null represents the empty state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial date value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the committed date value changes. The value is set to null while a typed draft is incomplete, invalid, out of range, or unavailable.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input segments, trigger, and calendar.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the input focusable while preventing edits. The calendar trigger is hidden in read-only mode.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Earliest selectable date (YYYY-MM-DD). Earlier typed dates mark the input invalid instead of being auto-corrected.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Latest selectable date (YYYY-MM-DD). Later typed dates mark the input invalid instead of being auto-corrected.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Marks specific days as non-selectable in both the input and the calendar.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled popover open state. Bindable.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial popover open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the popover opens or closes; details include the reason and a cancel() escape hatch.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether selecting a date in the calendar closes the popover.

props.name: children
props.description: DatePicker parts to compose inside the root.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the date picker when no visible label is associated.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the date picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while any part of the date picker contains focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the current segment draft is not committable.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the calendar popover is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the date picker is readonly.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: The segmented date input. Iterates the locale-resolved segments and passes each to the children snippet.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the input element so label[for] can target it. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: name
props.description: Name submitted with the form for the committed date value.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one segment per part; receives the segment descriptor. Defaults to plain segments.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the segmented input.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Overrides the invalid state exposed to assistive technology. Set automatically while the draft is not committable.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the date picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while a segment inside the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the current segment draft is not committable.

dataAttributes.name: data-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the calendar popover is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the date picker is readonly.

parts.name: Segment
parts.description: One editable or literal segment of the date (day, month, year, or separator). Supports typing and arrow-key stepping.

props.name: segment
props.description: The segment descriptor, as received from the Input children snippet.

dataAttributes.name: data-date-picker-segment
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a date picker segment element.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while the segment shows its placeholder instead of a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-type
dataAttributes.description: The segment type, e.g. 'day', 'month', 'year', or 'literal'.

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Button that opens and closes the calendar popover. Hidden in read-only mode.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the button, e.g. a calendar icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the trigger has focus.

parts.name: Popover
parts.description: The floating panel that hosts the calendar. Forwards Popover.Content props (placement, offset, shouldFlip, …); open state, trigger wiring, and id are controlled internally. Placement defaults to bottom-start and initial focus lands on the active day cell.

props.name: offset
props.description: Offset along the main axis from the anchor element.

props.name: placement
props.description: Placement relative to the anchor element.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Whether to flip when there's insufficient space.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: Boundary element for positioning constraints.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the popover.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the popover container.

props.name: nonModal
props.description: Whether the popover is non-modal (allows outside interaction, no focus trap, no scroll lock).

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether clicking outside the popover should close it.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Whether pressing Escape should close the popover.

props.name: shouldCloseOnBlur
props.description: Whether losing focus (blur) should close the popover. Defaults to true for non-modal popovers.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: Element or selector to focus first when modal trap activates.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state (standalone mode).

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: Reference to the trigger element (standalone mode).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes (standalone mode).

parts.name: Calendar
parts.description: The calendar surface inside the popover. Forwards Calendar.Root props except those controlled by DatePicker.Root (selectionMode, value, disabled, readonly, isDateUnavailable, …).

props.name: children
props.description: Calendar parts: triggers, heading, and grid.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Selection behavior: 'single' selects one YYYY-MM-DD date, 'range' selects a { start, end } pair.

props.name: visibleMonths
props.description: How many months are rendered at once and how paging advances.

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Whether days outside the current month are shown in the grid.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: Overrides the first day of the week specified by the active locale.

props.name: monthHeadingStyle
props.description: How the heading is rendered: 'composed' uses a locale-composed string, 'month-year' renders separate month and year parts.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Marks specific days as non-selectable. Unavailable cells stay focusable but expose aria-disabled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the whole calendar, including paging triggers and day selection.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the calendar navigable while preventing selection changes.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the root element. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered root element.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for the calendar when no visible label is associated.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date (single mode) or range (range mode). Bindable.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially selected date or range when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new date or range after a user selection.

parts.name: TriggerPrevious
parts.description: Button that pages the calendar to the previous month.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the button, e.g. an icon or label.

parts.name: Heading
parts.description: Displays the visible month heading, localized through the active locale.

parts.name: TriggerNext
parts.description: Button that pages the calendar to the next month.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the button, e.g. an icon or label.

parts.name: Grid
parts.description: Renders the visible month as an accessible grid named after the month heading.

props.name: children
props.description: Grid content, typically GridHeader and GridBody.

props.name: weekdayStyle
props.description: Width of the weekday header labels: 'narrow', 'short', or 'long'.

dataAttributes.name: data-calendar-grid
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the grid element.

dataAttributes.name: data-calendar-month
dataAttributes.description: The ISO month (YYYY-MM) rendered by this grid.

parts.name: GridHeader
parts.description: The weekday header row. Iterates the localized weekday labels and passes each to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one header cell per weekday; receives the localized weekday label.

parts.name: HeaderCell
parts.description: One weekday label cell inside the grid header row.

props.name: children
props.description: The weekday label content.

parts.name: GridBody
parts.description: The day cells area. Iterates the visible days and passes each ISO date to the children snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one body cell per day; receives the ISO YYYY-MM-DD date.

dataAttributes.name: data-week
dataAttributes.description: Identifies a week row inside the grid body.

parts.name: BodyCell
parts.description: One focusable day cell. Selecting it commits the date to the picker and (by default) closes the popover.

props.name: date
props.description: The ISO YYYY-MM-DD date this cell represents, as received from GridBody's snippet.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom cell content; receives the day number label. Defaults to the day number.

dataAttributes.name: data-date
dataAttributes.description: The ISO YYYY-MM-DD date of the cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day cannot be selected (disabled, out of range, or unavailable).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovered
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is over the cell.

dataAttributes.name: data-in-range
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day falls inside a selected range (range calendars).

dataAttributes.name: data-outside-month
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day belongs to an adjacent month.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the cell is actively pressed.

dataAttributes.name: data-range-end
dataAttributes.description: Present on the last day of a selected range (range calendars).

dataAttributes.name: data-range-start
dataAttributes.description: Present on the first day of a selected range (range calendars).

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the day is the committed value.

dataAttributes.name: data-today
dataAttributes.description: Present on today's date.

dataAttributes.name: data-unavailable
dataAttributes.description: Present when isDateUnavailable marks the day as unavailable.
